about: Spanish (message/us/uss.gmsg), for the same messages as the English table, in the Spanish text's own words (oprime, inventario, casilla). Tocar is also playing an instrument (004C, 1700, 1790 to 1792), so every edit names its message. The instruments' item texts name B to quit, which the English ones do not.
